name: Packages Pro
author: PyCmd
description: Packages for everything that is not Python. Fetches JavaScript and CSS libraries - htmx, Alpine, Tailwind, Bootstrap, three.js, Chart.js, D3, Vue, marked, highlight.js - and web fonts, straight from jsDelivr into a vendor/ folder in your workspace, so a page can use them with no CDN and no connection. Any npm package by name, too. Then it scaffolds whole projects: a Flask app with templates, a static site, an htmx page with its own backend, a three.js scene - each one ready for the Servers tab to run.
